---
title: "About this site"
toc: false
---

Your Simple Guide is a personal reference site. It collects links and instructions for different parts of my life so the people who need them can find them without asking me.

The site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and hosted free on GitHub Pages.

## Adding a new section

1. Make a new folder in the project, for example `recipes/`.
2. Add an `index.qmd` inside it with a title in the header block.
3. Add a link to it in the `navbar` section of `_quarto.yml`.
4. Run `quarto render`, then commit and push.
